_comment: Provenance and licence review for third-party dish data.
STATUS: nothing here is imported. The two best-matching datasets were licence-checked
on 2026-10-06 and both were refused. See `verdicts` below for the evidence. The
classification in scripts/classify-recipe-roles.mjs therefore remains hand-authored from
each pack's own category taxonomy, which is the more reliable source for the launch
Any future import must go through scripts/import-world-dishes.mjs, which refuses to
write anything until every licence claim about a dataset is known and permissive. The

verdicts.dataQuality: excellent fit — 765 dishes, only 1 mentioning Nepal

columnMapping.note: type_of_dish and time_of_day map cleanly onto our vocabulary. Implemented and tested in scripts/import-world-dishes.mjs, ready if the licence is ever cleared.

time_of_day.anytime, other: no restriction, expressed as an empty list

licenseClaims.note: Prose. Terms add that it is 'primarily intended for evaluating foundation models', permits 'careful fine-tuning', and prohibits using it to build 'prompt templates for the generation of training data'.
Machine-readable metadata distributed with the dataset.

blockingReason: The two official statements conflict, and the more restrictive one governs.
cc-by-nc-sa-4.0 is non-commercial, so it cannot be used in a product distributed
through the App Store and Play Store. Its share-alike term would also attach to
derived packs. We did not choose the permissive reading of LICENCE.md, because
picking the more convenient of two conflicting licence claims is exactly the mistake
additionalConstraints: Linked images carry their own per-row licences and some are known non-commercial; the authors also prohibit using the images for model training. Image columns are therefore dropped unconditionally by the importer.
Contributors consented to their photographs specifically, which is a narrower permission than a blanket dataset licence.
verdicts.toClear: Ask the maintainers which licence governs, and whether they will relicense the data (not the images) as CC-BY-4.0. Cite the conflict between LICENCE.md and the Croissant metadata.

verdicts.dataQuality: good taxonomy, but no dish role or meal time

licenseClaims.note: No license tag and no license field in cardData. Verified via https://huggingface.co/api/datasets/worldcuisines/food-kb.

blockingReason: No licence is declared, so nothing establishes permission to use it. An absent
licence is all rights reserved, not an implied open licence.
Separately, it carries no per-dish role or meal time, so it would not have solved
the problem we were solving even if it were licensed.
dataHygieneNote: The `alias` column contains respondent free-text that leaked into the data — the
'Arroz con maiz' row carries placeholder respondent fields including name, age and
city. Any use would need those rows stripped before the data went anywhere.
verdicts.toClear: Ask the publisher to publish a licence. Do not import rows in the meantime.

notReviewed.dataset: Kaggle — Food Lovers: Global Cuisine Preferences Survey
notReviewed.reportedLicense: CC0 (claimed in the dataset listing, not independently verified here)
notReviewed.note: Preference and geolocation survey data. No dish roles, so it cannot answer the question we had. Worth evaluating separately if we want 'what households here actually eat'.

notReviewed.dataset: Kaggle — Collection of Recipes around the world
notReviewed.note: Closest shape to RegionRecipe (ingredients, prep/cook minutes, servings, dietary) but carries no dish role, so it would need the same classification applied.

notReviewed.dataset: Open Food Facts / World Food Facts
notReviewed.note: Packaged-product data, largely covered by the OCR label parser already built. Lower priority.

notReviewed.dataset: Kaggle competitions — What's Cooking? / Cuisine Classification
notReviewed.note: Cuisine inference only. Competition terms restrict redistribution, so the gate would refuse it as not on the allowlist.

_roleVocabulary.mainCourse: A complete meal on its own. The only role eligible for a meal recommendation.
_roleVocabulary.sideDish: Served alongside a main course. Never recommended on its own.
_roleVocabulary.both: E.g. a rice dish that works as the meal and as an accompaniment.

_observedTypeOfDishValues.note: Full set of type_of_dish values across the 765 rows of source 1, counted from the actual CSV.

_observedTimeOfDayValues.note: Counts from the same 765 rows. 'lunch, dinner' dominating confirms meal time is real, not incidental metadata.
